## Implementation constraints

Follow AGENTS.md, the master and selected contract. No unrelated dependencies, paid services, production operations or later features.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Concrete observable result

## Verification commands / manual checks

List checks that exist or are introduced by this issue. Do not claim planned scripts have run.

## Security and failure cases

Use synthetic data. Do not paste secrets/private uploads/exploit details in this public issue; use SECURITY.md for vulnerabilities.

## PR deliverables

Scope, changed behavior, actual results, evidence and limitations.

## Stop point

Hand off this issue; no automatic next issue/milestone unless explicitly authorized.
